name: save_review_patterns
description: Review analytics, step 3: record which pattern each comment belongs to. Patterns are suggestions kept in Orwick's own store: the user switches them on in the app before they affect any review, so this asks nothing. Counts are worked out for you; the list holds at most 30 patterns, and one left without comments is removed.

groups.description: {"<comment id>": "<pattern id>"} for every comment read; "skip" for one that teaches nothing

merge.description: To shorten the list: {"<pattern id>": "<pattern id to move all its comments to>"}, or "skip" to drop a pattern that is not a general rule. A pattern left without comments disappears.

patterns.description: Patterns to add or reword: [{"id": "error-without-context", "name": "Error returned without context", "rule": "one sentence: what the code must do", "detect": "how to spot it in a diff", "example": "the code that drew the comment → the fix", "item": "the code-check item it belongs to, e.g. E1, or empty"}]
